failure_modes.name: Object Missed by Detector Candidate Generation
failure_modes.description: Ultra-distant sub-16px vehicle produces zero activations at 640px; candidate generator proposes no crop.
failure_modes.occurrence_rate: 42.6% of ultra-small GT in baseline YOLO640
failure_modes.mitigation: Fused motion differencing and static edge gradient salience.

failure_modes.name: Motion-Based Proposal Misses Stationary Object
failure_modes.description: Parked or red-light stopped vehicles produce zero inter-frame pixel differences.
failure_modes.mitigation: Complementary static visual salience and vanishing-line spatial prior.
failure_modes.outcome: Stationary objects captured by gradient contrast salience.

failure_modes.name: Camera Ego-Motion Creates Excessive Motion Proposals
failure_modes.description: Vehicle acceleration or turning causes whole-frame optical flow vectors.
failure_modes.mitigation: Global median displacement subtraction (residual flow thresholding) and upper component area cap.
failure_modes.outcome: Suppressed 91.3% of camera ego-motion false proposals.

failure_modes.name: Rain Streaks and Wiper Movement Create False Motion Regions
failure_modes.description: Windshield wiper blade sweeps across frame creating large high-contrast motion masks.
failure_modes.occurrence_rate: Observed on sequence b1e1a7b8 during active wiper stroke
failure_modes.mitigation: Geometric aspect ratio filtering and max component dimension cap (bw, bh <= 500px).
failure_modes.outcome: Wiper sweeps rejected before ROI crop creation.

failure_modes.name: Specular Wet Asphalt Reflections Generate False ROI Candidates
failure_modes.description: Puddle reflections on wet asphalt mirror oncoming headlights, triggering salience peaks.
failure_modes.occurrence_rate: Frequent on rainy night sequence b24380ab
failure_modes.mitigation: Conservative merge gating requiring new crop discovery confidence >= 0.35.
failure_modes.outcome: Suppressed 68 false alarms on wet pavement.

failure_modes.name: Static Salience Misses Low-Contrast Vehicles in Dense Fog
failure_modes.description: Vehicle paint matches foggy grey background, suppressing image gradients below 94th percentile.
failure_modes.mitigation: Multi-scale gradient enhancement and vanishing-point trapezoidal prior.
failure_modes.outcome: Road geometry prior guarantees center vanishing zone coverage.

failure_modes.name: Thermal Contrast Blooming Generates Saturated False Proposals
failure_modes.description: Hot exhaust pipes and overheated engine hoods bloom into saturated thermal white blobs.
failure_modes.occurrence_rate: Observed on FLIR thermal validation images
failure_modes.mitigation: Thermal dynamic range normalization and crop boundary margin suppression.
failure_modes.outcome: Exhaust blooming isolated; false alarms bounded.

failure_modes.name: Crop Budget Truncation Excludes Real Dispersed Objects
failure_modes.description: Frame contains 3 distant clusters, but crop budget K=2 drops the lowest-scored cluster.
failure_modes.mitigation: Dynamic clustering with cluster radius D=120px to group nearby objects into single 448px crops.
failure_modes.outcome: Groups 1.77 objects per crop, recovering 78% of third-cluster objects.

failure_modes.name: Clustering Merges Unrelated Distant Objects into Massive Crop
failure_modes.description: Two objects 400px apart connected by stray noise, creating an oversized 600px crop that loses magnification.
failure_modes.occurrence_rate: Occurs when clustering radius D exceeds 150px
failure_modes.mitigation: Strict cluster distance bound D <= 120px and max crop dimension bound (448px equivalent).
failure_modes.outcome: Maintains high spatial magnification on targeted sub-regions.

failure_modes.name: Crop Boundary Truncates Peripheral Vehicle Silhouettes
failure_modes.description: Candidate center placement places a bounding crop directly severing an oncoming vehicle.
failure_modes.mitigation: 20% context margin expansion (alpha=0.20) and 4px boundary edge suppression.
